comparison.objective: Drill a deep hole using peck cycles and clear chips, versus commission an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-axis alignment, controlled cutting feed, withdrawal, and chip evacuation versus hex-key insertion, collar tuning, counterholding, relocking, and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Hole depth/quality and chip clearance are title-implied; no body/specs, depth, diameter, runout, or force rubric is supplied. Candidate uses dynamic stroke and retention criteria.
comparison.reason: Subtractive machining and chip management are materially different from mechanical damping adjustment.
